svg.title: Make scenario: New feedback, score, check history, route
svg.desc: New feedback is watched in Google Sheets, the customer record is updated, complaint history is read, ChatGPT scores the feedback and a router sends it down one of five routes. Each route adds a row to Google Sheets and creates a Management Dashboard record; the two negative routes also email the manager.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
